description.en:
GRW is Fourier's wheeled, dual-arm robot for assistance, logistics and light manufacturing. Its adjustable body and paired arms support reaching, transferring and delivering objects, with a published stable dual-arm payload of up to 16 kg and a working height extending to roughly two metres.

The platform combines autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance with interchangeable end effectors. Fourier's FOCUS system supports control, communication and coordination between robots, while visual task tools help configure workflows. The manufacturer also describes battery exchange and protection features for ongoing operation. Actual handling and assistance tasks depend on the selected tooling and deployment setup.
